content_blocks.label: lead_paragraph
content_blocks.text: The city council's recent decision to ban plastic bags has divided residents and businesses alike, with environmentalists praising the move while local merchants argue it will hurt their profits.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_1
content_blocks.text: Environmental advocates have hailed the ban as a step towards sustainability, arguing that reducing plastic waste is crucial for the health of the planet.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_2
content_blocks.text: However, small business owners are concerned about the economic impact, citing the cost of switching to paper or reusable bags as a significant burden.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_3
content_blocks.text: Councilor Greenfield, who proposed the ban, stated in an interview, 'We must prioritize our environment over short-term financial gains.'

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_4
content_blocks.text: Opponents argue that such bans are ineffective and that they should focus on education and incentives rather than outright prohibition.

content_blocks.label: pull_quote
content_blocks.text: We must prioritize our environment over short-term financial gains.
